care_assignments_ended_reason_check.name: care_assignments_ended_reason_check
care_assignments_ended_reason_check.value: "care_assignments"."ended_reason" IS NULL OR "care_assignments"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL

consent_grants_active_profile_grantee_uq.name: consent_grants_active_profile_grantee_uq
consent_grants_active_profile_grantee_uq.where: revoked_at IS NULL AND grantee_profile_id IS NOT NULL

consent_grants_active_membership_grantee.name: consent_grants_active_membership_grantee_uq
consent_grants_active_membership_grantee.where: revoked_at IS NULL AND grantee_membership_id IS NOT NULL

consent_grants_grantee_exclusive_check.name: consent_grants_grantee_exclusive_check
consent_grants_grantee_exclusive_check.value: ("consent_grants"."grantee_profile_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("consent_grants"."grantee_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

outbox_lease_check.name: outbox_lease_check
outbox_lease_check.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'processing' AND "outbox_events"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'processing' AND "outbox_events"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

stored_objects_downloadable_check.name: stored_objects_downloadable_check
stored_objects_downloadable_check.value: "stored_objects"."downloadable" = false OR ("stored_objects"."upload_status" = 'finalized' AND "stored_objects"."scan_state" = 'clean' AND "stored_objects"."verified_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "stored_objects"."verified_sha256" = "stored_objects"."declared_sha256")

stored_objects_finalized_checksum_check.name: stored_objects_finalized_checksum_check
stored_objects_finalized_checksum_check.value: "stored_objects"."upload_status" <> 'finalized' OR ("stored_objects"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stored_objects"."verified_sha256" IS NOT NULL)

verification_documents_validity_order_ch.name: verification_documents_validity_order_check
verification_documents_validity_order_ch.value: "verification_documents"."issued_at" IS NULL OR "verification_documents"."expires_at" IS NULL OR "verification_documents"."expires_at" > "verification_documents"."issued_at"

verification_documents_decision_reason_c.name: verification_documents_decision_reason_check
verification_documents_decision_reason_c.value: "verification_documents"."review_decision_reason" IS NULL OR "verification_documents"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL

verification_documents_rejection_reason_.name: verification_documents_rejection_reason_check
verification_documents_rejection_reason_.value: "verification_documents"."status" NOT IN ('changes_requested', 'rejected') OR "verification_documents"."review_decision_reason" IS NOT NULL

appointment_slots_hold_check.name: appointment_slots_hold_check
appointment_slots_hold_check.value: ("appointment_slots"."state" = 'held' AND "appointment_slots"."held_until" IS NOT NULL AND "appointment_slots"."held_by_profile_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("appointment_slots"."state" <> 'held' AND "appointment_slots"."held_until" IS NULL AND "appointment_slots"."held_by_profile_id" IS NULL)

availability_exceptions_replacement_chec.name: availability_exceptions_replacement_check
availability_exceptions_replacement_chec.value: ("availability_exceptions"."is_unavailable" = true AND "availability_exceptions"."replacement_start_time" IS NULL AND "availability_exceptions"."replacement_end_time" IS NULL) OR ("availability_exceptions"."is_unavailable" = false AND "availability_exceptions"."replacement_start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_exceptions"."replacement_end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_exceptions"."replacement_end_time" > "availability_exceptions"."replacement_start_time")

health_alert_thresholds_org_scope_uq.name: health_alert_thresholds_org_scope_uq
health_alert_thresholds_org_scope_uq.where: patient_profile_id IS NULL AND retired_at IS NULL

health_alert_thresholds_patient_scope_uq.name: health_alert_thresholds_patient_scope_uq
health_alert_thresholds_patient_scope_uq.where: patient_profile_id IS NOT NULL AND retired_at IS NULL

patient_conditions_resolved_order_check.name: patient_conditions_resolved_order_check
patient_conditions_resolved_order_check.value: "patient_conditions"."resolved_date" IS NULL OR "patient_conditions"."onset_date" IS NULL OR "patient_conditions"."resolved_date" >= "patient_conditions"."onset_date"
